name: Red dunes
summary: Orange dunes just outside town: walk the slope and sandboard at sunset for the late-day color. Đồi cát bay is about 36.8 ha in Mui Ne ward, about 22 km from the Phan Thiet city center. Give the slope the end of the day. Bàu Trắng is the dawn ride.
getThere: A ride from the strip. About 22 km from the Phan Thiet center.
heroCaption: Orange slope, casuarinas, and walkers on the sand

notice.title: Come for the sunset
notice.body: Come as the sun drops past the horizon. Bàu Trắng is the 5:00–7:00 ride.

body: Walk the orange slope and sandboard as the sun drops. The red dunes sit just outside town. Đồi cát bay covers about 36.8 ha in Mui Ne ward. Since 2016 the provincial youth outdoor center has held the field, shared with the Ham Tien–Mui Ne tourism board and the ward.

The dunes are about 22 km from the Phan Thiet city center. The ride from a resort gate on the Ham Tien strip is its own trip. A motorbike covers the dunes and the coast. Bàu Trắng, in Hoa Thang, is the dawn field. This slope is the sunset.

figures.caption: Casuarinas along the crest of the orange dune
figures.alt: Orange sand dune at Mui Ne with casuarina trees along the crest

gettingThere: Đồi cát bay is the orange field in Mui Ne ward, just outside town and about 22 km from the Phan Thiet city center.
A motorbike covers the dunes and the coast. The 22 km starts at the Phan Thiet city center, so the Ham Tien strip is a separate ride.

legs.heading: From the Ham Tien strip
legs.body: A motorbike along the coast. The 22 km starts at the Phan Thiet city center.

legs.heading: From Phan Thiet
legs.body: About 22 km from the city center, just outside town.

admissionNote: The provincial youth outdoor center manages the field, with the Ham Tien–Mui Ne tourism board and the ward. Come at sunset.
